labels.comments:
The location was perfect for seeing our family. The room is a studio, so it is small and its perfect for crashing and relaxing. Lots of information from the host as to things to do! We were there to see family, so the agenda was full. There are 3 sets of locks to get in, this is good on one hand challenging when carrying luggage in.
The biggest negative was not having a way to know about the party going on in the room down the hall till 2am, so while it says private room. Its a converted hotel, and very cool! Yet we didnt know about the other rooms being allowed to party till the early morning.
I would stay again.
Bob
Jay’s place was awesome. Great location and exactly as shown in the photos. Communication was really easy and Jay was always accessible. Would stay again and recommend.

This apartment is exactly as advertised. It is clean and spacious. The check in is super easy with a keypad. The apartment is private and quiet. It is also well equipped with everything one would need. The hosts are thoughtful and helpful. The location is ideal, within walking distance of a great shopping area. There was no issues at all! Thank you, Cristina and Tomas!

We had a very pleasant stay, everything was communicated to us in a timely manner and we had no issues whatsoever. It was such a relaxing time and  a good location to walk around the city. Would definitely go back again :)
Really great host. Didn’t really have much issues. Whenever I needed to ask anything he responded promptly.

If there was a 5 ⭐️ plus we would give it here. A unique artistically decorated apt in an upscale neighborhood with many fun businesses and eateries within walking distance. Very beautiful outdoor space. Very clean and accommodating indoor space. Top notch hosts. Thank You!

We wanted an escape to Toronto for our Anniversary and Manni's condo was the perfect spot. Excellent location, close to all in downtown Toronto. Very clean and well equipped condo, has everything you need for your stay. Communication with Manni was good, always checking in with us to see if there was anything to make our stay better. Highly recommend this location. Thank you Manni for making our stay an awesome one.
Paul & Glenda
Staying at Cristina’s place was great. Location was perfect and the place was clean and communication was easy! Looking forward to staying again.

We really enjoy staying at Donata’s place. She has a fantastic taste with decorating the place and makes it so cozy and comfortable with it’s layout. Very thoughtful with everything (the place is well stocked with everything you need) and communication and instructions are so helpful and clear!
Another big bonus other than the apartment itself and the host is it’s location! Directly connecting to PATH, right next to union station, plus grocery store and LCBD right downstairs..etc. if you have a car the parking space is great also.
We’ll definitely recommend to stay at Donata’s place!
The place is just like the photos and Ben it's a top guy, always answering and willing to help

The room is very clean, warm and cozy, shared bath and kitchen are also very clean with all the appliances. The host is very friendly and always there to help. And the location is great - playgrounds, supermarkets, drugstores, restaurants - max 5-8 min walking, bus stop is right here. I do highly recommend this accommodation.
This condo is a great option for business travellers. It’s conveniently located with a great view of downtown and Lake Ontario. It is nicely decorated and has all the amenities at home.
Everything was perfect about this place. Especially the balcony and all the goodies left in the fridge for us. Would love to stay here again.
Clean and pleasant basement apartment, right near the beach. Just what we needed for an overnight stay.

Kevin’s place is a great loft apartment, loved the natural light and high ceilings. I feel very lucky to have found his place as there aren’t many lofts available in downtown Toronto.
Thank you Kevin

First of all the pull out couch was so dirty and washroom floors were dirty and zev is a person who’s trying to scam money off you after your trip to make more money about a cleaning feee buddy I paid for the cleaning feee so for you to tell me that I spilled alcohol I don’t even drink which is a lie and then after that I smoked outside not in your house cameras can even see I smoked outside

We had a great time during our stay in the condo. Still feels like we're home. The place was clean. And Caitlin was very responsive at our questions. Restaurants are just around the area. Highly recommended if you are a group of 5 people

David’s place was one of the most well furnished locations I have been to for long stays at Airbnb. He’s got you covered with all the essentials and more. He is accommodating with pets and is a delight to communicate with. Always ready to support, have a chat, exchange ideas.
Definitely recommend this to anyone looking to stay in a location that is in downtown with great accessibility, budget-friendly, and well equipped. Pet friendly is a big bonus.
Great place. Helped me out last minute as we needed emergency accommodation near the vet clinic our dog was at when we came from out of the city.
Stayed here to attend a concert and it was perfect! close to a lot of amenities but not too deep in the city! Shannon provided great instructions and was very responsive to any needs!
